# dsh-peak-badge
A floating **DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing badge** for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI. It tells
you at a glance whether DeepSeek tokens are currently billed at peak or off-peak rates — based on *
*Beijing time**, with zero configuration.

> 🟢 **Off-peak hours** — light green pill: 「优惠时段 · 半价」 (off-peak, half price)
> 🟠 **Peak hours** (09
:00–12:00, 14:00–18:00 Beijing time) — light orange pill: 「高峰时段 · 单价×2」 (peak, 2× price)
## Why
DeepSeek introduced peak/off-peak pricing (峰谷计费) on 2026-08-17: during the peak windows **09:00–12:0
0** and **14:00–18:00** (Beijing time), token prices are **2×** the off-peak rate. This badge keeps
that status visible at all times so you can decide whether to keep chatting or defer the expensive w
status visible at all times so you can decide whether to keep chatting or defer the expensive work.
## Features
- **Always current** — refreshes every 30 s using `Intl.DateTimeFormat('Asia/Shanghai')` (no manual

timezone setup).
- **Draggable** — move it anywhere; the position is remembered in `localStorage` an

d clamped to the viewport.
- **Click for details** — a card shows the current Beijing time, the peak

/off-peak windows, and reference prices for DeepSeek V4-Flash / V4-Pro.
- **Zero host risk** — pure

browser plugin; the host half is a no-op.
- Complements the text-rule reminder in `AGENTS.md` for ag
ents working in basecamp-style repositories.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart `dsh web`, then hard-refresh the browser (Cmd+Shift+R on macOS / Ctrl+Shift+R elsewhere). Th
e badge appears at the bottom-left by default — drag it wherever you like.
## Usage

- **See status**: green = off-peak, orange = peak. The pill also shows the current Beijing time.
- *

*Drag**: press and hold, move, release. Position persists across refreshes.
- **Details**: click (wi
thout dragging) to open/close the info card.
## Reference prices (effective 2026-08-17, CNY per million tokens)
| Model | Peak input / output | Off-peak input / output |
Cache hits are billed at half the input price. Always check the official pricing page: https://api-d
ocs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing
